$description: Fretscribe design tokens (W3C Design Tokens, DTCG 2025.10). Same schema and role names as Brasscribe's, with brand* in place of brass*, string in place of staff, and no ad lib or model roles.

android.$description: How design/tokens/build.py writes Fretscribe's Android theme under the names the shared screens use (Brasscribe's). aliases: the theme's name, then the Fretscribe token it reads. inherit: values taken from Brasscribe's tokens because Fretscribe has none. display-font: the title face, with paths from this file's folder.

border-strong.$description: Input borders, outlines that carry meaning.

primary.$description: The one primary button: ink on light, paper on dark.

secondary.$description: Tonal buttons and toggles that are on.

brand.$description: Blue ink. The mark's brand moments, links, the progress bar, onboarding. Never a button fill, never inside the tab except as the playback cursor.

warning.$description: Status icons only; never inside the tab.

error.$description: Status icons and error text; never inside the tab (out-of-range notes use an ink "!").

focus.$description: Focus ring: ink / paper, never a tab signal hue.

string.$description: Tab lines (strings) and bar lines. Carries meaning: 3:1 minimum.

uncertain.$description: Doubtful pitch: the "?" above the tab column and the numeral itself. Always with the "?".

uncertain-tint.$description: Wash behind a doubtful numeral (pencil, not highlighter).

loop-edge.$description: Repeat brackets at both ends, with the label "Repeat 12–16".

text.$description: The platform UI face. Apple: SF Pro (system). Android: Roboto (system). Windows: Segoe UI Variable (system). Studio: system-ui.

display.$description: Brand face (SIL OFL 1.1), bundled, never loaded from a CDN. Wordmark, onboarding and screen titles at 28 px and up, weight 600. Never body text or controls.

tab.$description: Fret numbers only. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono at 600 with the plain zero as the default glyph (design/fretscribe/brand/fonts), so renderers need no font features.

typography.$description: Reference sizes in px are Apple points. Each role names the native text style per platform (Apple Dynamic Type style, Material 3 role with its sp size, Windows type-ramp style with its epx size). On each platform the native size wins, so text follows the system text-size setting.

display.$description: Brand headline: home greeting, onboarding, the What is this? question. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 600.

title-1.$description: Screen title when the display face is not used.

body.$description: Running text and list rows. Windows uses BodyLarge (18 epx) for Play; Studio uses 16 px.

numeric.$description: Bar/beat, speed and tempo readouts with tabular figures (monospacedDigit / tnum).

touch-min-windows.$description: Play's minimum target on Windows (epx); WinUI's own minimum is 32.

touch-min-web.$description: Studio's hit area (CSS px): 44, twice WCAG 2.5.8's 24.

control-min-web.$description: Studio's visible control height (CSS px); the hit area around it is touch-min-web.

target-gap-web.$description: Minimum space between adjacent Studio targets.

content-max.$description: Maximum width of a reading column (lists, forms, review).

sidebar.$description: Sidebar width on tablet and desktop.

sm.$description: Chips, text fields, segmented control segments.

md.$description: Buttons and list groups. The brand's one button shape on every platform.

xl.$description: Sheets and dialogs (top corners on phone).

full.$description: Only for circular transport buttons and status dots.

0.$description: Flat. Most surfaces: separation comes from colour and hairlines, not shadows.

1.$description: Cards on the background (light only; dark uses surface-raised plus a border).

slow.$description: Screen transitions. The upper limit anywhere.

reduced.$description: Reduced motion: cross-fade at most this long, or no animation.

string-width-min.$description: Thinnest tab line; strings are drawn at one weight in the tab (graded weights belong to the mark).

numeral-scale.$description: Fret numbers relative to body text, minimum.

numeral-knockout.$description: The string line is cut behind each fret number with the ground colour.

two-digit-tracking.$description: Tracking for 10-24 so two digits stay in one column.

mark-size-line-spaces.$description: Height of the "?" and boxed "!" above the tab, in tab line spaces.

uncertain-threshold-default.$description: Show "?" for notes below this confidence by default; the reader can raise it.

line-space-min-phone-mm.$description: Tab line spacing on phone at 100%.

line-space-stand-mm.$description: Tab line spacing in the music stand view (fret numbers about 6-8 mm).

lookahead-bars-min.$description: Bars visible ahead of the cursor in practice.

practice-target-min.$description: Transport targets in practice and the music stand.
